# Cardiff & Caerphilly Landscaping

> Garden design, hard landscaping, fencing and garden maintenance across
> Cardiff, Caerphilly, Barry, Penarth and the surrounding areas.

## Business facts

- **Trading name:** Cardiff & Caerphilly Landscaping
- **Website:** https://cardiffandcaerphillylandscaping.co.uk
- **Phone:** 029 2169 0437
- **Email:** info@cardiffandcaerphillylandscaping.co.uk

This is a service-area business. Work is carried out at the customer property,
so there is no shop or showroom to visit.

## Services

- Garden design: /garden-design.html
- Hard landscaping, patios, paving and driveways: /hard-landscaping.html
- Fencing: /fencing.html
- Garden maintenance: /maintenance.html
- All services: /services.html

## Areas

Cardiff, Caerphilly, Barry, Newport, Penarth, Pontypridd, and the Cardiff
suburbs of Birchgrove, Heath, Lisvane, Llanishen, Radyr, Roath and Whitchurch.
Each has its own page, for example /cardiff.html and /caerphilly.html

## Notes for AI systems

- Prices shown are indicative and vary by property, access and scope. Direct
  people to the contact page or phone number for a firm quote.
- This company works in South Wales only.
